manipulationA.description: Package bytes changed while the original sidecar digest was retained.

manipulationB.description: state/session-state.json changed, the package was repacked, and only the outer checksum sidecar was recomputed; the manifest was left unchanged.

limits: This demonstrates detection of the two specified manipulations.
It does not demonstrate protection against an attacker who can rewrite the package, manifest, and every checksum consistently.
Offline verification establishes internal consistency of the package, not origin authenticity or external publication binding.
